blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines —Karl Eldrew Yulo proved that Philippine artistic gymnastics has a bright future, winning a bronze medal to cap his first Asian Games stint on Friday at Nagoya General Gymnasium. A young gymnast facing established competitors, the 18-year-old Yulo was unfazed and confidently executed a clean routine in the horizontal bar final, scoring 13.666 points on a 5.0 difficulty as the second performer. The young dynamo’s performance was enough to secure a bronze medal, edging Kazakhstan’s Milad Karimi, who also scored 13.666 points but on a 5.8 difficulty. […]...
